content: तक्षन् {%m.%} [तक्ष्-कनिन्] .²1 A carpenter, wood-cutter (whether by caste or profession); तक्षा रिष्टं रुतं भिषग् <ls>Rv. 9. 112. 1</ls>; तक्षाणः पलगण्डाश्च … <ls>Śiva B. 31. 18</ls>; अताक्षा तक्षा <ls>K. P.</ls> one not a तक्षन् by caste is called तक्षन् when he acts like or follows the profession of a तक्षन (carpenter); <ls>Śi. 12. 25</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the architect of the gods.
